name: How should I prepare my kitchen before backsplash installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my kitchen before backsplash installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the installation crew arrives, clear all small appliances, dish racks, and countertop clutter so technicians have full access to the wall space. Pull movable kitchen islands away if space is tight, and remove breakables from nearby open shelving. It is also helpful to have your chosen switch plates and outlet covers on hand. Technicians will inspect the underlying drywall, turn off power to the backsplash outlets, and protect your countertops and flooring with drop cloths.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all items from your countertops, empty open shelves near the work zone, and ensure power to kitchen wall outlets can be temporarily shut off.
